title: Admin Web V2 Media Browsing And Item Detail Governance
problem: Admin Web V2 can manage a Media Library, but operators still lack a governance-oriented /catalog and /items/:itemId inspection workflow for Media Items, Media Sources, metadata authority, artwork/NFO readiness, and support evidence.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test -- App.test.tsx adminApi/client.test.ts adminApi/dataSource.test.ts
cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build

evidence.summary: Opened the media browsing and item detail governance lane from the closed library-management parity split.

Audited current public/admin browse and item detail route readiness, accepted public-read bridges for /catalog and /items/:itemId, and split metadata diagnostics, generated artifacts, admin artwork, and repair actions to follow-ons.

Implemented route-owned /catalog browse/search using explicit public-read bridges for /items and /search, URL-owned q/facet/limit/offset params, safe summaries, deterministic fallback, redaction tests, and desktop/mobile browser smoke.

Implemented route-owned /items/:itemId governance detail using getPublicItemDetailBridge, bounded live source probes, safe summaries, readiness placeholders, deterministic fallback, redaction tests, and desktop/mobile browser smoke.

Re-scored item-scoped repair/action gaps and split Generated Artifact review/actions, item artwork selection, catalog repair/actions, safe metadata diagnostics, item NFO status/actions, and playback support detail into bounded follow-ons.
Closed the media browsing and item detail governance lane after final Admin Web gates, browser smoke, closeout review, evidence updates, and follow-on split.

continue_policy.notes: This lane is complete. Open admin-web-v2-generated-artifact-review-actions as the recommended next Admin Web V2 lane.
